Time Zone Converter

Enter one date, time and source time zone, then pick up to 20 target zones: every row is derived from a single resolved UTC instant and shows the local time, the UTC offset and the day shift. If the source time falls in a daylight-saving gap or overlap, the page says so in words — it never quietly prints a plausible-looking answer for a time that never happens.

    Conversions use the time-zone database built into your browser/device. If a government changes a zone's rules, devices with an older database can show different results until they are updated.

    This tool runs entirely on your device: nothing is sent anywhere and the date-time you enter is never stored.
